senses.gloss: ch. same, to lift up; to suspend, hang; to be hanged. [Targ. Y. Ex. II, 16 Ar. (ed. Vien. דלא; h. text דלה).] Targ. Jer. X, 12.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 38:25">Targ. Y. Gen. XXXVIII, 25</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 20:12">Targ. II Chr. XX, 12</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 15:3">Targ. Ez. XV, 3</cite>.

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 13:12">Targ. Prov. XIII, 12</cite> (ed. Lag. <cite ref="V00023"><he>תָּאלֵי</he></cite>); a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="V00023"><he>תָּלֵי</he></cite>; f. <cite ref="V00588"><he>תַּלְיָא</he></cite>; pl. <he>תָּלְיָן</he>, <he>תָּלְיָין</he>. Targ. Y. Deut. l. c. Ib. XXVII, 14 Ar. (ed. <cite ref="T00783"><he>רמא</he></cite>; h. text <cite ref="T00780"><he>רם</he></cite>); a. fr.—Y. Sot. I, 17ᵃ top <he>ההין … ואת תְּלֵית עינים וכ׳</he> this man (thy husband) feeds and sustains thee, and thou liftest thy eyes up to another man? <cite ref="Ketubot 71b">Keth. 71ᵇ</cite> [read:] <he>תְּלַתְנְהוּ</he>, v. <cite ref="S01210"><he>קִישּׁוּט</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 39b:9">Yeb. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>בדידך ת׳ רחמנא</he> the law makes it dependent on thee (leaves thee the choice).
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:14">Cant. R. to V, 14</cite> <he>מִיתְלֵי</he>, v. <cite ref="P01148"><he>עִקְבָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 7b">Ab. Zar. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>תַּלְיָא וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A03315"><he>אֶשְׁלָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Ketubot 2a:4">Keth. 2ᵃ</cite> <he>ת׳ תניא בדלא וכ׳</he> he hangs that which has been distinctly taught on that which has not been taught, i.e. draws a conclusion from the unknown to the known; <cite ref="Bava Batra 134b:5">B. Bath. 134ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 3:3:13">Y. Bicc. III, 65ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>אתר תלי</he> an elevated place.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 5:2:4">Y. Succ. V, 55ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>כל דתלי מאה וכ׳</he> a column a hundred cubits high requires a base of thirty-three.

<cite ref="Gittin 37b:2">Gitt. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>ת׳ ליה עד וכ׳</he> he must look up to him, until he says so (that he gives him the money, although he is not bound to pay it); [Rashi: and he is suspended (tortured) until &c.].

<cite ref="Bava Batra 47b:7">B. Bath. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>תַּלְיוּהָ וזבין וכ׳</he> if they suspended (tortured) him, and he agreed to sell, the sale is valid; <cite ref="Bava Batra 48b:4">ib. 48ᵇ</cite> (not <he>תלויה</he>); <cite ref="Bava Kamma 62a:13">B. Kam. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>תְּלוּהָ</he>.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3:22">Lam. R. to III, 65</cite> (play on <he>ת̇א̇ל̇ת̇ך</he>, <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3:22">ib.</cite>) <he>ת̇לי … כל א̇ל̇ות̇ וכ׳</he> (some vers. <cite ref="V00576"><he>תְּלֵה</he></cite> h.) force them through suffering, and bring upon them all the curses &c.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:6">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ</cite> top <he>תלה לון יומא וכ׳</he> the day remained suspended for them (the sun did not set), until every one of them reached his home; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3:7">Y. Keth. XII, 35ᵃ</cite> <he>תלת</he> (corr. acc., or <he>תלא</he>).—[Pesik. Par., p. 37ᵇ <he>ותלין</he>, read: <he>זחלין</he>, v. <cite ref="G00248"><he>זְחַל</he> II</cite>.]

senses.gloss: to be hanged. Targ. II Esth. II, 23.
